title: McKinnon's hard drives seized by Office of Naval Intelligence

tellings.quote: And when I got arrested, all my data was taken to OI, Office of Naval Intelligence. So they still have my hard drives. I've tried to get them back for years and they said, "No, it's still an ongoing investigation. You can't touch it."

plain: A British hacker named Gary McKinnon, who says he found signs of a secret NASA space programme, says that when he was arrested in 2002 all his data went to the Office of Naval Intelligence, which still has his hard drives. He tells Michels he has tried for years to get them back and was told, "No, it's still an ongoing investigation. You can't touch it."
